newsitem.title: CHINA: PRESS DIGEST - Chinese newspapers - June 20.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Chinese newspapers - June 20.

text.p: Following is a summary of major Chinese political and business stories in leading newspapers, prepared by Reuters in Beijing. Reuters has not checked the stories and does not guarantee their accuracy. Telephone: (8610) 6532-1921. Fax: (8610) 6532-4978.
PEOPLE'S DAILY
- China develops new Yinhe-3 supercomputer capable of performing 13 billion calculations per second, marking breakthrough for China in developing large-scale computer systems.
- Foreign Ministry spokesman Cui Tiankai announces China has agreed to appointment of Robert Francis Cornish as Britain's first Consul General in Hong Kong Special Administrative Region
XINHUA DAILY TELEGRAPH
- Xinhua commentary discusses importance of China's resuming exercise of sovereignty over Hong Kong.
- Frontpage article calls for more attention to protection of cultivated land in bid to guarantee economic development.
BEIJING DAILY
PEOPLE'S DAILY OVERSEAS EDITION
CHINA SECURITIES
- Fixed asset investment in western regions reaches 32 billion yuan in January-April, up 31.8 percent and 17.8 percentage points higher than eastern areas
- Editorial warns of side-effects of rapid new share issues
FINANCIAL NEWS
- China to check and regulate fees on construction projects, aims to boost property market
- Central bank tightens up spending, bans construction of new buildings for three years, bans officials from extravagant eating and drinking
- Industrial and Commercial Bank of China outstanding loans reach 1.833 trillion yuan an end-May
- Retail sales of consumer goods seen at 218 billion yuan in June, up 12.8 percent year-on-year
CHINA BUSINESS TIMES
- State Animal and Plant Quarantine Administration issues rules to tighten control on imports of U.S. poultry
CHINA DAILY

- China prepares for another nationwide competition to find cleanest cities. State departments will check on environmental sanitation, public health publicity, and quality of drinking water in public places of more than 600 cities
- State Council issues circular saying laws and regulations covering approval of foreign investment and the licensing of mining must be strictly obeyed.
